name: Timers
description:
Multiple countdown timers and clock-time alarms in the top panel.

Type a time the way you say it, such as 5m, 12m pizza, 1.5h, 5 min, @14:30 or 7 am, and press Enter. Save presets with their own sound and keyboard shortcut, and start recent timers again with one click.

Quiet by default: a finished timer plays its sound once, shows a notification and clears itself. Follows Do Not Disturb, the 12/24-hour clock and time zone changes, and keeps counting on the lock screen.
